facts.fact: Lands Minister Hamat Bah said on 4 September 2026 that the government is developing a Land Information System to digitise records of landholdings, with World Bank-supported consultants working on it and a draft expected by end-September 2026.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands and Regional Government

note: Policy calls for a digitalised NLAS and notes the absence of a centralised LIS; no system procured, piloted or built is stated.
Speech says the policy calls for a digital National Land Administration System; prospective only, no system stated as procured, piloted or built.

facts.fact: Dr Samba Sowe of the Land Policy Implementation Unit said the alpha version of the National Land Information System is complete and in testing before full rollout.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Local Government and Religious Affairs

facts.fact: The Standard reports the Ministry of Lands' Director of Planning said a contracted company is developing a digital land registry and online land information system, due in 2027, with testing scheduled to begin the next May.
facts.system: Digital land registry / online land information system

systems.system: Digital land registry / online land information system
systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Regional Government and Religious Affairs

facts.fact: Minister Hamat Bah said a tender for the National Land Information System attracted nine firms, with evaluation and contract signing expected in early 2026.
